annotation.summary_en: Two men hide a bottle of moonshine from a nosy neighbor and practice avoiding the police by role-playing a search, only to have the real police drink it all.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a cramped, old-fashioned apartment. One man tells a boastful story about his uncle (hopar) arriving in a modified VAZ-2106 to rescue him and giving him a bottle of potent home-distilled moonshine (samagon). Afraid that their nosy neighbor has already reported them to the police, the two men decide to play a game to test their hiding spots. One man puts on a military peaked cap and role-plays a police officer (progressively 'promoting' himself from Lieutenant to Colonel) who 'searches' the apartment for illegal alcohol. Each time the 'officer' finds the bottle—first near the dresser, then under the trophy-topped TV—they celebrate by drinking a glass to test the quality, concluding that if it was found, it 'wasn't hidden well enough.' By the time a real police officer actually arrives at the door following a tip, the men are already tipsy. When the officer demands the illegal moonshine, the man dryly informs him that his 'colleagues' already came by and drank the entire bottle.
catchphrases: ձերոնք մի քիչ առաջ եկան սաղ խմեցին ու գնացին
